info.name: 牛金
label: 防御
过牌
爆发
info.biography: 初为曹仁部曲将，周瑜军数万人来攻，前锋数千人始至，曹仁登城望，乃募得三百人，遣牛金迎战。但对方兵力较多，牛金遂被围困。曹仁亲自杀入阵中救出牛金。司马懿使牛金轻骑饵诱蜀军，刚交战诸葛亮就退兵，追至祁山。蜀将马岱入寇，司马懿遣将军牛金击退，斩千余级。公孙渊反，司马懿率牛金、胡遵等步骑四万发自洛阳，后平定辽东。
info.characteristic: 开局拥有大量手牌，杀死敌人获得大量手牌。受到延时锦囊牌的影响较小。

skills.name: 挫锐
skills.text: 锁定技，游戏开始时，你将手牌数摸至X张（X为场上角色数）。当你成为延时锦囊牌的目标后，你跳过下个判定阶段。

skills.name: 裂围
skills.text: 当你杀死一名角色时，你可以摸三张牌。

interpretation: Use the official OL hero584 skill pair, not another product or older cuorui initial-hand bonus.
Official API hp=4; initial_hp=0 means no override. Page OpenGraph hp=0 is inconsistent and not authoritative.
Opening refill is max(0, living player count - current hand count), without discarding existing cards.
Delayed use targeting, including self-targeted Lightning, arms a persistent one-next-Judgment skip; moving a delayed card without a use does not arm it.
Liewei requires the frozen death killer to be the owner and remains optional.
The next-judgment debt is consumed after all Preparation children, before checking any existing phase skip, and survives source loss; whole face-down skipped turns do not consume it.

rootVerification.visualEvidence: Actual WPF gallery controls rendered offscreen and viewed for all three new generals.
